properties.name: Kingdom of Kush
properties.borderNote: approximate — Napatan/Meroitic-era canonical extent; Nile-corridor + Butana steppe

properties.name: Xiongnu Confederation
properties.handCraftedNote: Includes Ordos and Hexi at peak; western Tarim oases were tributary.

properties.name: Kingdom of Khotan
properties.matchedRegion: Khotan / southern Tarim Silk Road oases

properties.name: Xianbei Confederation
properties.handCraftedNote: Deeper Manchurian extent than Xiongnu; Hexi only loosely held.

properties.name: Rouran Khaganate
properties.handCraftedNote: Northern Wei blocked southern advance; Tarim held only loosely.

properties.name: Kingdom of Makuria
properties.handCraftedNote: Makuria along the Nile from Aswan to 6th cataract (Khartoum)

properties.name: First Turkic Khaganate
properties.matchedRegion: First Turkic Khaganate under Muqan Khan
properties.handCraftedNote: Pan-Eurasian span from Caspian to Khingan; split into East/West 603.

properties.name: Eastern Göktürk Khaganate
properties.handCraftedNote: Tang controlled Ordos/Hexi; Türk realm shifted off the Wall line.

properties.name: Western Göktürk Khaganate
properties.handCraftedNote: Pontic steppe to Hindu Kush; absorbed into Tang protectorate 657.

properties.name: Eastern Göktürk Khaganate (Second)
properties.handCraftedNote: Same core territory as first khaganate after Ilterish/Bilge revival.

properties.name: Uyghur Khaganate
properties.handCraftedNote: Capital Ordu-Baliq; Beshbalik / Turfan southern garrison towns.

properties.name: Pechenegs
properties.handCraftedNote: Volga to Lower Danube; raided Byzantium / Crimea; ended by Komnenos 1091.
